<div class="doxyMemberDoc">

<p>Insert a BTI/PACBTI instruction into a given basic block <span class="doxyComputerOutput">MBB</span>.</p>


<p>If <span class="doxyComputerOutput">IsFirstBB</span> is true (meaning that this is the first BB in a function) try to find a PAC instruction and replace it with PACBTI. Otherwise just insert a BTI instruction. The point of insertion is in the beginning of the BB, immediately after meta instructions (such labels in exception handling landing pads).</p>
